## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Include an example when useful.

## Documentation

- [ ] Updated the affected current guides and canonical references, or explained why no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] Updated the helper/caller map if a helper or caller changed.
- [ ] Kept private configuration, credentials and application evidence out of the diff.

Guidance: [documentation maintenance](../docs/DOCUMENTATION.md).

## Validation

List the relevant checks and results, including skipped or unavailable checks.
Keep detailed private logs/JUnit in the ignored artifacts area.

## Rollout

Describe affected processes, migrations, deployment verification and rollback if applicable.
